anomalous_propagation_clutter.description: Transient non-meteorological ground return caused by refractive propagation.

biological_birds.description: Bird echo, including migration, roost, or local flight activity.

biological_insects.description: Insect echo or an insect-dominated biological layer.

biological_other.description: Biological echo that cannot be assigned confidently to birds or insects.

class_boundary.description: Transition pixels excluded from strict gate-level scoring.

clear_air_atmospheric.description: Non-precipitating atmospheric echo, including Bragg or turbulence structure.

invalid_measurement.description: Decoded but invalid, saturated, corrupt, or geometrically impossible data.

isolated_speckle.description: Isolated unsupported gates that are not part of a coherent echo.

mixed_coherent_signal.description: Overlapping weather, biological, or clear-air signal that remains scientifically valid.

other_coherent_signal.description: Coherent measured return not covered above; retained by default.

precipitation.description: Rain, snow, hail, melting-layer, or other precipitation echo.

radial_interference.description: Radial, spoke, or other radio-frequency interference.

receiver_noise.description: Receiver or processing noise without coherent atmospheric structure.

sea_clutter.description: Sea-surface return rather than an atmospheric echo.

static_ground_clutter.description: Persistent terrain, building, mast, or other stationary ground return.

uncertain.description: Evidence is insufficient for a remove or retain judgement.

wind_turbine_clutter.description: Wind-turbine return, including Doppler-broadened turbine contamination.

selection.description: 24 independent PVOL volumes per radar and pulse: six UTC slots in each season, split by date into development, validation, and holdout
selection.leakage_control: Every listed source is excluded from learned-background training; all sweeps from one PVOL remain in the same split.
